 instagram tiktok facebook twitter youtube News RAYE 2nd date at London’s BST Hyde Park Festival 2027: date, presale, ticket prices and guide
 Sienna Spiro will support the award-winning London singer in Hyde Park next July. Here’s how to get tickets
 Written by Ed Cunningham News and Features Editor, UK Wednesday 18 November 2026 Share Copy Link Facebook Twitter Pinterest Email WhatsApp Image: supplied | RAYE at BST Hyde Park 2026 Advertising At the start of the month it was revealed that former Time Out cover star RAYE  will headline BST Hyde Park . After the first date sold out, today (November 18) the south London star has announced a second headlining slot at the day festival. 
 London is clearly struggling to find music venues big enough to handle RAYE. After headlining All Points East in 2025 and playing six nights at the O2 Arena earlier this year , in 2027 she’ll play two dates at BST.
 The ‘Where Is My Husband!’ and ‘Escapism’ singer is headlining British Summer Time in 2027 alongside  Bon Jovi  and Muse . Mercury Prize- and GRAMMY-winning superstar RAYE will be supported on both dates by Sienna Spiro.
 Find out everything you need to know about getting tickets, from presale to pricing, below.
 When is RAYE playing BST Hyde Park 2027? 
 The south Londoner’s homecoming dates in Hyde Park are on
 Saturday July 10 2027 
 Sunday July 11 2027 
 Image: AEG RAYE at BST Hyde Park 2026 
 When do RAYE BST Hyde Park tickets go on sale? 
 General sale for the second date goes live at 10am on Friday November 20 2026 . You can purchase on the BST Hyde Park website here .
 Presale details 
 There is one main presale to know about:
 Wednesday November 18 at 1pm – Amex presale
 Ticket prices 
 For first release, expect pricing to start from around  £90  (excluding fees).
 Who is supporting RAYE at BST Hyde Park? 
 Sienna Spiro has been confirmed for both RAYE dates in Hyde Park. More names will be announced closer to the dates.
 Image: supplied Sienna Spiro 
 Who else is headlining BST Hyde Park 2027? 
 Bon Jovi and Muse have also so far been confirmed for BST 2027.
 Thursday June 24, 2027 – Bon Jovi
 Saturday June 26 2027 – Muse
 Saturday July 10 2027 – RAYE
 Sunday July 11 2027 – RAYE
 Last year the festival series was headlined by Garth Brooks , ATEEZ , Maroon 5 , Mumford and Sons , Duran Duran , Pitbull and Lewis Capaldi .
 Did you see that Robyn and the Pussycat Dolls will headline Mighty Hoopla 2027 ?
